title: A history the memory returns between two tool rounds stores the long results of the turn's earlier rounds for read_stored_result, a preview in their place, as the emergency compaction does, and sends the last round's, which the model has not read yet, whole
notes: Python's _compact_after_round stores, with with_results_stored (channels/_compaction.py), each result longer than 2,000 characters of the rounds between the turn's input and its last round, a preview of 1,000 characters in its place. Here the memory hands back nothing after the first round, then an empty history after the second: the first round's result (2,899 characters) is stored, the second's goes whole.
